references.text: This reference shows the fulfillment of Jacob's promise to see Joseph before his death.
Highlights how God's faithfulness fulfills Jacob's longing to see Joseph again.
Typological parallel: God's salvation makes it possible for the family to return home when the threat is gone.
The physical reaction (sitting up) confirms the intensity of Jacob's words that he would see Joseph before he died.
Contrast between sending away and reunion, showing God's faithfulness through the ages.
